violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. Observed employee wash hands in the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS asked employee to wash hands in proper hand washing sinks.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink in main service line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Paper towels placed in area of handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of ice cream toppings.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS discussed container usage with PIC.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Interior of microwave
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean the interior of the microwave.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the Wall behind the main prep table in back prep area is in need of cleaning. Observed that the storage racks over the waffle making station is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS discussed areas of cleaning with PIC.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the 3 VAT SINK being used to dump drinks.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Discussed food usage in sinks with PIC. PLEASE UTILIZE THE PREP SINK OR 3 VAT SINK FOR FOOD USE.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3 COMPARTMENT SINK with a concentration of LESS THAN 150ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. Another sanitizer tablet added to sink solution, observed at 200ppm. Please train all staff to test sanitizer concentration when made.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: MIXER observed washed and rinsed in 3 compartment sink after use and placed to dry.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Mixer placed in sanitizer solution.
